from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SLANT_DEBATE_WORKER_PROMPT] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SLANT_DEBATE_AGG_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        debated = await debate(problem)
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SLANT_FORMATTER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.SLANT_FORMATTER_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.SLANT_FORMATTER_PROMPT_C],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SLANT_FORMATTER_AGG_PROMPT,
        )
        solution = await star(problem + "\n\nCandidate to format:\n" + debated["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

- the given number grid is the vertex clue grid

- inspect all proposals in {all_proposals}

{problem}
